global_recreation_rules.purpose: Recreate the visual DNA of each selected reference while adapting the subject and copy to new content.
preserve: the reference composition and visual hierarchy
the use of texture and depth
the balance between content and negative space
quality_requirements: Use a portrait 4:5 canvas unless another format is requested.
Maintain readable typography at mobile-screen size.
Render physical objects with believable material properties and shadows.
Keep decorative elements subordinate to the main message.
Use the selected design DNA consistently throughout the composition.
Do not combine unrelated reference styles unless explicitly requested.
Do not invent extra text or branding.
Keep all generated copy accurate and correctly spelled.
agent_execution_protocol: Extract its color palette, layout, typography, and rendering rules.
Map the new content to the existing visual hierarchy.
Replace reference-specific objects only when the new subject requires it.
Generate the composition while retaining the chosen design's defining visual characteristics.
